description.narrative: The Project will contribute to pro-poor sustainable economic growth in western Guangxi and northern Viet Nam. This will be achieved by developing an efficient, safe, and environment- friendly regional transport system to promote trade in, and through, western Guangxi and reduce trade barriers with Viet Nam.

Value of trade through Pingxiang, Longbang, and Yuexu increases by 15% per annum during 2010- 2012 Progress/Status: Being assessed. Data Source: Guangxi Commence Department and Baise Border Trade Bureau Actual value:

Vehicle operating costs for a passenger car are reduced from CNY1.45 per vehicle-km in 2006 to CNY1.26 in 2012. Progress/Status: Assessment ongoing. Data Source: Estimation of vehicle operating costs by GCD and ADB Actual value:
Travel distance is reduced by 34 km from Baise to Guizhou border after the Project Progress/Status: Assessment ongoing. Data Source: PCR Actual value:

Value of small-scale crossborder trade in Jingxi county increases from CNY 380 million by 20% per annum over 5 years Data Source: Guangxi Commence Department and trade data compiled by Baise border trade bureau Actual value:
Travel time between Baise and Longlin by car reduced from 5 hours in 2006 to 2 hours. Progress/Status: Assessment ongoing. Data Source: Travel time survey for the expressway Actual value:

Administrative villages with all-weather road access increased from current 52% to 100% of the total by 2012 in the project area Progress/Status: Works on licensing bus services being undertaken. Data Source: Provincial and county statistics offices Actual value:

Licensed bus service becomes available to 100% of villages targeted by the project in 2012, from 54% in 2006 in the project area Progress/Status: Being assessed. Data Source: Baise Transport Administration bureau Actual value:

Traffic on the project corridor increased by 9% per year during 2006-2012 from a baseline of 6,439 pcu in 2006. Progress/Status: Assessment ongoing. Data Source: Actual traffic data on the expressway through its auto-monitoring system Actual value:
